name: Erc

attributes.attribute: a warrior woman of the Fianna
died of grief at her brother's murder

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Erc is an Irish hero or heroine whose name means salmon or speckled. Several minor characters, both male and female, carry this name. One was a warrior woman who fought beside Fionn mac Cumhaill, serving in his war-band, the Fianna. A second bearer of the name was a man, the brother of Achall. Achall died of grief after her brother's murder. The name gathers several small figures into one cluster.
